cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Record My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get your contribution formally recognized, recorded, or repeated where it cannot be quietly forgotten.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Will you put my name under 'cake design' before you frame our club's prize certificate? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Next year's members won't. There's a blank ready for them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We usually credit the whole baking team.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: List us all, with what each did. I'll fetch everyone's names before you seal the frame.

mechanism: A directs completing a prize certificate, accepts whole-team credit and gathers names while preserving A specific cake-design contribution in the sealed record.
confusable: Unlike just wanting to be thanked, A needs a permanent role attribution future members can read.
comparison: A framed club certificate with all contributors differs from minutes and an unfulfilled party thank-you.
seedUse: D177-b cake-design blank, future members and team names; S02-b expands credit and does name retrieval.
